name: Partial Diamond Mesh Volume
definition: A partial DMV (∆ p) is a sparse representation of a scalar field where only relevant diamonds are encoded, subject to a transitive closure constraint: if a diamond δ belongs to ∆ p, then all ancestors of δ must also belong to ∆ p.
summary: Partial Diamond Mesh Volume is a sparse scalar field representation that clusters diamonds into supercubes to reduce storage overhead compared to explicit methods.
